posts.title: The Kentish Town flood, days before we opened

posts.title: From Bintang to BUNSO, eight restaurants from one Kentish Town family since 1987
posts.summary: In 1987 a Filipino mum and a Bangladeshi dad opened a restaurant in Kentish Town with five people on the staff. Nearly forty years later the Maginhawa Group runs eight, and BUNSO is the youngest. This is the family, in the order they arrived.
